capabilities: Plan tasks on a full monthly calendar view with Monday week starts
Add, edit, and delete checkbox tasks via a modal window
Show monthly completion statistics (total, done, percentage)
Export a day's tasks to a dated note
Add a day card to an Obsidian Canvas
extras: All data is stored in a single Calendar Task Planner.json file in the vault with no network requests. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in monthly calendar view for planning and tracking tasks day by day in one place.
summary: Monthly calendar planner that lets you add, edit, and check off tasks on day cards, with monthly statistics and note or Canvas export.
